NEAR_AI_API_KEY.description: Add your own [NEAR AI Cloud API key](https://cloud.near.ai). Cloudflare stores it as a Worker secret; it is never shipped to the browser or committed to the copied repository. Provider usage is billed to your account.

PHALA_API_KEY.description: Add your own [Phala Cloud API key](https://cloud.phala.network). It is stored as a Worker secret and used only for the fixed Phala confidential route.

DEMO_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Set a strong, unique token (20-256 characters). Visitors must enter it before the Worker accepts any provider-billed route. Share it only with people you authorize.
